mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production over a 6-month period, indicating supply constraints, will drive inflation higher and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: 6mo % change in INDPRO < -2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts series HOUST rises above a 12-month high, signaling a strengthening housing market, consumer spending will increase, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 12mo high but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds the CPI inflation rate, signaling a tightening of monetary policy, S&P 500 returns will be negative over the next 60 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > CPIAUCSL but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth accelerates by more than 200,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, signaling a rapidly tightening labor market, wage inflation will drive S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 2mo acceleration in PAYEMS > 200k jobs/mo but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Real estate investment, as measured by the RSAFS series, leads the broader economy. When RSAFS declines by more than 5% over a 6-month period, a recession is likely, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 6mo % change in RSAFS < -5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered recession periods.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) both decline simultaneously over a 3-month period, signaling a supply-driven economic slowdown, S&P 500 returns will be negative over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: 3-month % change in INDPRO < -1% AND 3-month change in UNRATE > 0.5pp
failure_condition: 3mo % change in INDPRO < -1% AND 3mo change in UNRATE > 0.5pp, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.
